resources.string: This image is not Budokai Tenkaichi 2 (USA, SLUS-21441). Budokai Tenkaichi 3 is installed on the BT3 tab.
That was a Budokai Tenkaichi 2 image: it is ready on the BT2 tab.
In the game, press back twice to return to the app.
Included: BT2 Recomp, the game\'s code recompiled for Android.
BT2 draws with Vulkan 1.3 (paraLLEl-GS): Adreno 600 and newer, Mali G57 and newer. On Adreno a custom driver (Drivers page) can help.
Packs in PCSX2\'s format for SLUS-21441
Copy the pack\'s folder (the one that holds \"replacements\") into this folder with a file manager or adb:
Changes apply from the next game start.

BT2\'s engine reads the disc image itself, so it has no file-override mods like BT3\'s yet. Images with mods that only change data (textures, models, sounds) and keep the original SLUS_214.41 work: pick them on the Home page. Mods that change the game\'s program do not, because the engine runs code recompiled from the original program.
The game\'s own picture in 16:9 instead of 4:3.
Pictures between the fights\' 30 frames. Heavy: for strong GPUs.
Cheat codes are not supported by BT2\'s engine yet.
Native is the lightest. Smoothed keeps the resolution and softens edges; High and above draw at twice the resolution and need a strong GPU.
Sharp pixels; off: the picture fills more of the screen.
FPS, game speed, CPU and GPU over the game, live. Also in the in-game menu.
Simpler drawing of heavy see-through effects (fog, glows). Faster on weak GPUs; may change some effects slightly.
Textures always at full detail, without their smaller copies. Can be faster; distant surfaces may shimmer.
Every BT2 run is logged: the device, the GPU and the settings when it starts, the engine\'s messages when it ends.
Save the BT2 report to Downloads
The last ten runs\' logs are kept in bt2/user/runs, in the app\'s folder.
The driver chosen here is used by BT2 only; BT3 keeps its own.
Plays from a card of its own with a 100% save: every character, stage and item. Your own save stays on its card; switch this off to go back to it.
The unlock-everything save is not included in this build.
From the next start BT2 uses the \"Tudo desbloqueado\" card. Your current card is kept and comes back when you switch this off.
The picture is made smaller and the screen enlarges it: less work for the GPU on weak phones, a little softer. Also in the game\'s menu (pause button).

The game reads drawn pictures back from the frame before, without waiting for the GPU: the processor and the GPU work at the same time. Much faster where the game reads the screen every frame; an effect that uses it may be a frame late.
Skips copies of the finished picture. Faster in some scenes; may show wrong pictures in a few.
Screen resolution and these options also change during the game, in its menu (pause button).
Back button or the pause button: continue
Look, opacity, button layout, shown or hidden.
Skip frames instead of slowing down
When the GPU can\'t keep up, the game keeps its speed and a frame is not drawn (never two in a row).
FIFO: steady, a little more delay. Mailbox: no tearing. Immediate: least delay.
Effects that redraw the screen over itself: distortion, trails, blur. The heaviest for the GPU; off makes battles faster.
BT2\'s engine draws its effects as the PS2 did, so they are turned off by kind, not one by one as in BT3. Changes apply at once.
Fast: Dragon Rage\'s BT3 renderer, with the GPU\'s own drawing; smooth on phones. Exact: the PS2\'s GS pixel by pixel; heavy.
Vulkan is the default and the fastest. OpenGL ES is an alternative for Mali GPUs whose Vulkan driver fails.
Shares the graphics work with another processor core: more FPS and speed. Turn it off if the game stutters or shows errors.
Online play for Budokai Tenkaichi 2 is not available yet.
The BT2 engine is not part of the app: download the motor package (.zip) on the Dragon Rage Discord and import it here.
The installed motor (version %1$s) is for another version of Dragon Rage. Download the motor for this version on the Discord and import it.
This file is not a BT2 motor package.
This motor is not an official Dragon Rage one (its signature does not match) and was not installed.
The motor package is incomplete or damaged: download it again.
This motor (version %1$s) is for another version of Dragon Rage: download the one for this version.
BT2 cannot be played until a motor is imported again. The disc image, saves and settings are kept.
